steps.name: CPENGRAMS (Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare)
steps.when_to_use: For initial pension-related grievances regarding disbursement or processing.

steps.name: Appellate Authority (CPENGRAMS)
steps.when_to_use: If the complainant is not satisfied with the redressal of the grievance.
steps.timeline: File within 30 days of closure; disposed within 30 days
steps.typical_wait: File within 30 days of closure; disposed within 30 days

steps.name: RBI Ombudsman
steps.when_to_use: If no reply has been received from the Bank within 30 days of receipt of the complaint, or if the complainant is not satisfied with the bank's resolution regarding the life certificate/pension disbursement.
steps.timeline: File within 90 days from the date the timeline expires or the date of the last communication from the Bank
steps.typical_wait: File within 90 days from the date the timeline expires or the date of the last communication from the Bank
steps.source: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Salient features, para 2

note: CPENGRAMS is the primary mechanism for Central Government Pensioners. If the issue persists specifically due to the Bank's failure to process the life certificate, the RBI Ombudsman is the appropriate regulatory escalation path.
sources: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Salient features, para 2
